scope: One supported physical Nova; software, signed-APK and hardware register checks. No new optical measurements.
additional_candidate_device_cases: Version 1.0.0 rejects an empty saved property even with an identity live matrix.
An empty property restored to 1.1 at reboot; accepting an empty value alone was not sufficient.
Confirmed reset from an empty property, followed by Gamma 2.2 application and a neutral reboot.
A live 0.8 adjustment with saved 1.0 was detected; reset, sRGB application and reboot succeeded.
Restore original remained available with a live 1.1 adjustment; reboot restored original hardware state.
Saved 1.000 required normalization; confirmed reset and subsequent Gamma 2.2 reboot succeeded.
English and Italian reset dialogs visually inspected. All six locale key sets checked in the final APK.
candidate_scope: The legacy rejection and the empty-property reboot were investigation checks. The additional reset/apply cases used the same installer asset and translated reset text as the final APK. Final change added obscured-touch filtering to dialog buttons; final APK was retested separately as listed above.
limitations: The original reporter's device has not been retested by the maintainer.
The live matrix dump rounds to three decimals and is not an optical measurement.
Another app or system setting can subsequently override saturation; there is no background enforcement.
Host mocks do not replace the physical device tests reported separately.
